method: Node VM with current production-script chain and ordinary arcadeInput. Direct level-7 entry fixtures; not a browser or human playtest. Lag pilots observe enemy positions from 0.35/0.60 seconds earlier, own position current; decisions each 0.12 seconds.

checks.name: Six authored waves, 90/78 visible ships, original three packets and two safe education cases
Normal movement picks up all three real supplies, with bounded effects and unchanged upgrades
Full pause/save roundtrip preserves real pickups, dives, bullets and deterministic continuation
Warning clocks stay nonnegative; the same formation can shoot again after its first volley
Reinstallation is idempotent and adds no handlers or wrappers
In-flight 1.9 saves retain original three-wave mechanics and deterministic physics
Gameplay outside level 7 is byte-identical between old and new mechanics

stress.scope: Repeated complete missions in one Node VM through ordinary inputs; distinct seeds, both modes and 30/60 Hz. Simulated duration is not browser wall-clock uptime. Heap figures include harness/UI and the last engine; only forced-GC measurements are retained-heap evidence.
